Recorder.Name: Debug recorder
Recorder.Label: Open the recorder
Recorder.Hint: Record debug data about Dxcufgb's modules into one file to attach to a bug report. Names, chat and journal text, the world's title and the server's address are never recorded.

AutoStop.Name: Stop recording after (minutes)
AutoStop.Hint: A recording stops by itself after this many minutes, so it can't run on by accident.

Open.Name: Open the debug recorder
Open.Hint: Opens the Debug Recorder window (GM only). No key is set by default.

App.Title: Debug Recorder
App.PrivacyNote: Only technical data is recorded: versions, settings without their text, errors and what the modules report. Names, chat, journal text, the world's title and the server's address are removed before anything is stored. Look at the preview before you share the file.
App.ModulesHint: Dxcufgb's modules that are active in this world. Errors from other modules are recorded too, without their logs.
App.NoModules: None of Dxcufgb's modules is active in this world.
App.RegisteredHint: This module sends the recorder a snapshot of its own state.
App.AutoStop: A recording stops by itself after {minutes} minutes. Starting again adds a new recording to the list. Only this GM client is recorded in this version.
App.ReportHint: Optional. Saved in the file. Names you type here are removed as well.
App.PreviewEmpty: Click "Show the file" to see exactly what the exported file will contain.
App.PreviewNote: The preview shows at most the first 300,000 characters. Export builds the file again with fresh snapshots and anything recorded since, so open the downloaded file and check it before you share it.
App.PreviewSize: The whole file, {size}. Exporting builds it again, with what happened since.
App.PreviewTruncated: The first {shown} characters of {size}. The export has everything.
App.ZipHint: Export a single recording as a .zip (smaller to upload). Files over {size}, and two or more recordings, are always zipped.
App.CopyByHand: The browser didn't allow copying. Select the text below and copy it (Ctrl+C).
App.RecordingsHint: One recording per bug. Give each a name, then tick the ones to download or delete. Shift-click ticks every recording between the one you clicked last and this one. Two or more download as one .zip.
App.NoRecordings: No recordings yet. Start one for each bug you want to report.
App.LabelHint: Name this bug. The name is used for the file name and saved in the file; names of characters, scenes and so on are removed from it as well.
App.View: Show this recording's counters, report fields and preview
App.DownloadHint: Downloads the ticked recordings. Two or more always download as one .zip with a file per recording.

Indicator.Label: Debug recording
Indicator.Tooltip: The GM is recording debug data for a bug report. Names, chat and journal text are not recorded.

Confirm.DeleteBody: These recordings are deleted. Download them first if you still need them.

Notify.Started: Debug Recorder: recording. It stops by itself after {minutes} minutes.
Notify.Stopped: Debug Recorder: recording stopped. Name it in the list, then download it to attach it to the bug report.
Notify.AutoStopped: Debug Recorder: recording stopped by itself after {minutes} minutes.
Notify.LostOnReload: Debug Recorder: the page was reloaded during a recording, so that recording is lost.
Notify.NoZip: Debug Recorder: this browser can't make .zip files, so the plain JSON file was saved.
Notify.TooBig: Debug Recorder: the file would be {size}, more than {max}. Record a shorter session or fewer modules.
Notify.NothingSelected: Debug Recorder: tick at least one module to record.
Notify.GMOnly: Debug Recorder: only a GM can record.
Notify.Failed: Debug Recorder: something went wrong. See the console (F12) for details.
Notify.NoZipMany: Debug Recorder: this browser can't make .zip files. Download the recordings one at a time.
Notify.NothingPicked: Debug Recorder: tick at least one recording to download.
Notify.TooMany: Debug Recorder: the list holds at most {max} recordings. Delete some to start another.
